author: steven5703
body:
He's been constantly harassing me and accusing me of "glitch abusing".
The funny thing is, I catch him abusing a glitch in this video; but it's a diff one then the one he's been accusing me of (stair tapping)

I have 3 videos of him doing this; I hope he get's at least a week tempban, but that's your decision. Some of them aren't finished uploading. So if you have about 20 minutes of free time and feel like doing a report, watch these videos of him Harassing me, being rude (saying "eZ" over and over again), glitch abusing, and false accusing me;

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pHuKSESSvWY&feature=youtu.be
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rtyRfCnSQzQ&feature=youtu.be (this is the video of him abusing the pre-game glitch)
